data.name: TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION
data.detailed_description:
THE MOST COMPLETE TENNIS GAME

TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION is the most lifelike tennis simulation ever released, showcasing the essence of gameplay on court and the challenge of managing a career through an entire season of 100 official tournaments against 150+ officially licensed pros. Now including the four Grand Slam events alongside the complete ATP and WTA tours, as well as team events United Cup and Laver Cup. Feel the power of the racquet in the palms of your hand – there really hasn’t been a tennis experience like TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION!

A ROSTER OF UNPARALLELED QUALITY AND DEPTH

An unprecedented roster of professional men’s and women’s players, featuring immortal stars such as Novak Djokovic, Aryna Sabalenka, Roger Federer, Maria Sharapova, Rafael Nadal, and Caroline Wozniacki. Play a tournament on the men’s circuit against Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, Alexander Zverev, Daniil Medvedev, Felix Auger-Aliassime , Ben Shelton, Taylor Fritz, Lorenzo Musetti, Nick Kyrgios and Stefanos Tsitsipas. Face off with the likes of Iga Swiatek, Coco Gauff, Elena Rybakina, Mirra Andreeva, Amanda Anisimova, Emma Raducanu, Jasmine Paolini, Elina Svitolina, Jessica Pegula or Naomi Osaka on the women’s circuit. Each of these legendary players has been studied with minute detail to reproduce their signature techniques and strategies, attacking and defending with their own unique playing style.

THE COMPLETE OFFICIAL CALENDAR

There is no challenge like the official ATP and WTA tours to test your abilities, and TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION allows you to follow the authentic schedule across multiple years. Embody an official player or create your own. Play on all of the Grand Slam courts. Represent your country in the United Cup and Laver Cup. Sign up to compete in the Masters 1000 and the WTA 1000 tournaments. Carefully plan your schedule of ATP/WTA 500 and 250 tournaments to improve your skills and bolster your ranking, as you will need to be ranked in the top 8 in order to qualify for the ATP Final or WTA Final; the crowning jewels of the season.

RELIVE SOME OF THE GREATEST MATCHES

Revisit some of the greatest moments in tennis history with the greatest players. Play every one of the ATP all time Number 1 ranking leader “Nole’s” record-breaking triumphs in the Novak Djokovic Grand Slam Challenge. Celebrate Maria Sharapova’s career in the Maria Sharapova World Tour. Choose a side in one of tennis’s greatest rivalries – Federer v Nadal. Re-live the history of the Laver Cup, with every event featured from its inaugural year in 2017.

LIFE-LIKE REALISM

The TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION Dev Team has taken player animations to new heights. They have travelled the world to capture authentic signature movements of players to deliver a realistic, immersive experience. Take on Djokovic’s impregnable service return, jump to return Nadal’s powerful topspin forehand, and watch out for Federer’s slice backhand. Challenge yourself to learn each star’s iconic moves and find a way to beat them.

data.short_description: TIEBREAK - GRAND SLAM EDITION Compete in more than 100 official tournaments against over 150 officially licensed professionals. Take on the complete ATP and WTA Tours, including the Australian Open, Roland-Garros, Wimbledon and the US Open.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 2100 (3.1GHz) / AMD FX 6300 (3.5Ghz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX770 (4 GB) / AMD Radeon R9 270 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Though not required, SSD for storage is recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 6600k (3.5GHz) / AMD Ryzen 5 1600X (3.6Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1660 Ti (6 GB) / AMD RX 5700XT (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Though not required, SSD for storage is recommended
